each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def pieces(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cs=comps_of(g)
    out=[]
    for c,cells in cs:
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs_=[cc for _,cc in cells]
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs_),max(cs_)
        h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
        shape=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r,cc in cells: shape[r-r0][cc-c0]=c
        # normalize position by top-left of bounding box
        out.append((c,[(r-r0,cc-c0) for r,cc in cells],(r0,c0)))
    return out

def find(piece,go):
    c_,cells,_=piece
    r0,c0=min(r for r,_ in cells),min(cc for _,cc in cells)
    h=max(r for r,_ in cells)-r0+1; w=max(cc for _,cc in cells)-c0+1
    s=set(cells)
    H=len(go);W=len(go[0])
    res=[]
    for ri in range(H-h+1):
        for ci in range(W-w+1):
            if all(0<=ri+i<H and 0<=ci+j<W and (go[ri+i][ci+j]==c_ or go[ri+i][ci+j]==0) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)) \
               and all(go[ri+i][ci+j]==c_ for i,j in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if (r0+i,c0+j) in s]):
                res.append((ri,ci))
    return res
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    occ=[(c,set(cells)) for c,cells in comps4(g)]
    # order right-to-left by min column (rightmost first)
    occ.sort(key=lambda x:min(k for _,k in x[1]))
    placed={}
    for c,s in occ:
        s=set(s)
        best=0
        while True:
            ok=True
            for r,kc in s:
                nc=kc+best+1
                if nc>=W: ok=False;break
                if any((r,nc) in v for k,v in placed.items()): ok=False;break
            if ok: best+=1
            else: break
        placed[c]=s
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c,s in placed.items():
        for r,kc in s: out[r][kc]=c
    return out

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    occ=[(c,set(cells)) for c,cells in comps4(g)]
    # order right-to-left by max column
    occ.sort(key=lambda x:max(k for _,k in x[1]))
    placed=set()
    res={}
    for c,s in occ:
        s=set(s)
        best=0
        while True:
            ok=True
            for r,kc in s:
                nc=kc+best+1
                if nc>=W: ok=False;break
                # adjacency to any placed cell (orthogonal)
                if any((r,nc+dr) in placed or (r+dr,nc) in placed for dr in (-1,0,1)): ok=False;break
            if ok: best+=1
            else: break
        res[c]=s
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c,s in res.items():
        for r,kc in s: out[r][kc]=c
    return out
